name: @spar/client-source
description: Spar's TypeScript SDK sources (plan section 2b). Shipped compiled as the /sdk subpath of an app's @spar/app package; never published on its own.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.vite.json && vite build -c vite.telemetry.config.ts
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.vite.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.vite.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
